capability.title: From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles

capability.summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly used for probabilistic forecasting across diverse domains, yet the reliability of their uncertainty estimates remains poorly understood. capability.title: Evaluating Uncertainty Calibration in Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Models

capability.summary: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. capability.title: Four Bridges: Measuring Deception Propensity in a Multi-Agent Game

capability.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments

capability.title: DiabAgent: Toward Agentic Physiological Control

capability.summary: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. capability.title: NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains

compute.summary: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. compute.title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training

embodiment.title: Exploring Proximity and Tactile Sensing for Robotic Manipulation

embodiment.summary: Conventional robot arms can be extremely heavy compared with the everyday objects they manipulate, creating a significant inertia mismatch at contact. embodiment.title: When Robots Outweigh Objects: How Inertia Mismatch Shapes Robot Policy Learning

embodiment.summary: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. embodiment.title: Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation

embodiment.title: TAMPAgent: Agentic Belief-Space Planning for Mobile Manipulation

embodiment.title: Mediating Human-Swarm Interactions Through a Robot Helper: A Shepherding-Inspired Approach

embodiment.summary: Navigating crowded urban environments requires robots to avoid pedestrians while adhering to social norms such as remaining on sidewalks. Existing approaches typically address either crowd avoidance or semantic path planning in isolation. embodiment.title: PanoTac: A Dense Three-Axis Tactile Sensor for Robust Touch-Centric Manipulation
